report: MyAppFactory V4.0 Batch 3 Quality, Testing and Compatibility
overall_decision: Quality QA workflow implemented and exercised; manual and security assurance work remains.

milestones.name: Automated Testing Engine
evidence: Discovers unit/widget/API/offline/regression test suites by path and integration_test files.
Runs discovered suites only when --execute is explicitly supplied; integration tests require a selected Android device.
Aggregates results, preserves per-suite command logs, redacts environment secrets from output, and keeps missing suites NOT RUN.
QA engine executed 2 generated-sample Flutter test files successfully; both tests passed.
limitations: Test categories without matching files are intentionally NOT RUN, not PASS.
Integration test execution was not performed because the generated sample has no integration_test suite.

milestones.name: Android Device Compatibility QA
evidence: Reads minimum and target API levels from APK manifest metadata using Android aapt.
Discovered emulator-5554: Android 16 (API 36), Android arm64.
Generated sample APK manifest reported minSdk 24 and targetSdk 36.
Installed and launched the generated development app com.dev.batchthreeqa.dev; adb confirmed a live process and foreground activity.
Smoke-test safety refuses installation if the selected package is already installed or APK identity does not match the project.
limitations: Only one Android 16 emulator was available and smoke tested.
Compact phone, typical phone, tablet, alternate Android versions, screen densities, and permission scenarios remain untested.
The smoke-tested package remains installed on the emulator; the QA tool does not automatically uninstall it.

milestones.name: Accessibility and UX QA
evidence: Static heuristics report actionable interactive-control and gesture semantics findings with source file and line.
Flutter analyzer passed on canonical Nova UI and on generated sample.
Generated sample scan produced 11 review findings, which are heuristic review items, not confirmed accessibility defects.
milestones.contrast_review: PARTIAL — named literal color pairs are measurable; no applicable pairs were found in the generated sample.

manual_reviews.check: TalkBack/VoiceOver reading order and control names
Text scaling at 1.3x and 2.0x; check clipping and overflow
Contrast measurement for actual rendered color pairs
Touch target size and reduced-motion behavior
Form error announcements and app-specific UX review

limitations: Static source heuristics and flutter analyze do not establish accessibility conformance.
No formal accessibility certification or manual assistive-technology test was performed.

milestones.name: Performance and Stability
evidence: Generated-app Android profile APK build passed.
Measured profile APK size: 66741643 bytes (66.7 MB), SHA-256 1729da3f8f77efb876b7a9ba99c3414b4155505527301281808c6a7c285ce5df.
Android 16 emulator cold first-launch measurement recorded TotalTime 5217 ms and WaitTime 5231 ms; process and foreground activity were confirmed.
No per-app performance thresholds were configured, so the recorded measurements were not judged against a configured SLA.
limitations: Profile APK size is not installed-size evidence.
One emulator launch is not a representative performance benchmark.

milestones.name: Dependency, Vulnerability and License Audit
evidence: Canonical pubspec.lock inventory: 26 packages.
flutter pub deps --json completed successfully.
Android Gradle releaseRuntimeClasspath dependency inventory completed successfully after preserving Batch 2 release-signing protection.
CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM generated with 26 components at design_system/nova_ui_flutter/build/factory_quality_qa/20261101T065925-6ab3e630/bom.cdx.json.

vulnerability_scan.availability: Neither scanner is installed in this environment; no CVE scan was performed.

limitations: Dependency and SBOM inventories are not vulnerability scans.
License-file presence or declared identifiers are not legal compatibility approval.

validation.evidence: Read-only; no differences and no files changed.
Structural checks passed; manual and Flutter checks remain separate.
All 10 consolidated checks passed, including the quality QA dry run.
Safely refused because release signing is not configured; no release was produced.

manual_verification_required: TalkBack/VoiceOver reading order and control naming.
Large text, overflow, contrast, keyboard focus, touch targets, and reduced motion.
Compact, typical, tablet, density, and additional Android API-level device matrix.
Frame/memory profiling, crash capture, and sustained stability.
Human review of license compatibility and any future vulnerability scanner findings.

release_safety.reason: Batch 3 is QA-only. No release authorization or signing keys were provided.

next_milestone: Stop after Batch 3 and obtain user review. Do not start V4 Batch 4.
